candidate.title: Support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for migration from ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft has been removed
candidate.text: Support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for migration from ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft has been removed. Please make sure all your clusters are using KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer!

evidence.locator: L30-L31 (0.46.0 › Major changes, deprecations and removals)
evidence.excerpt:
* **Support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for migration from ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft has been removed.**
  **Please make sure all your clusters are using KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer!**
